conviction_note: The print is mainly a guidance event. DEA has used its Q3 release to give the next year's first Core FFO guide two years running (2025 guide in Oct 2024, 2026 guide in Oct 2025, when a $3.085 midpoint against $3.11 consensus coincided with a -4.0% day), so abs_move is set above the 3.82% median at 4.5. The sourced 2027 items lean slightly negative: the FAA leaves ~186k RSF in Des Plaines on 2026-10-20, a $127.5M 3.6% mortgage refinances in summer 2027, and at $22.5 the stock sits below management's own threshold for accretive acquisitions. Mid-to-high-teens rent growth on 2027 renewals and the FDLE lab delivery offset part of that. No 2027 consensus could be sourced, so every 2027 finding is capped small and p_up is only 45. The findings sum to -0.8 against a scaled -0.45; the difference is the unsourced 2027 bar.
bar: Q3 2026 Core FFO/share consensus $0.79 from two sources: Earnings Whispers (https://www.earningswhispers.com/stocks/DEA via search snippet; the same site put Q2 at $0.78 vs $0.79, https://www.earningswhispers.com/epsdetails/DEA) and Benzinga's Q3'26E of $0.79 (https://kr.benzinga.com/quote/DEA/earnings-forecasts, search snippet; page 403 on fetch). The FY2026 guide is $3.07-$3.13 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001622194/000162219426000024/dea-ex99_1.htm). With H1 at $1.55, the midpoint implies about $0.775 a quarter for H2, so $0.79 sits inside the guide's upper half. FY2026 consensus is $3.09-3.10 (Seeking Alpha / Earnings Whispers). FY2027 consensus: UNSOURCED (only a proprietary model figure was found), so the 2027-guide findings are capped small.
positioning_check: Short interest 2,138,684 shares at the 2026-09-30 settlement, 4.52% of shares outstanding (higher as a share of float), 3.78 days to cover. It has risen at four straight settlements from 1.90M on 2026-08-14 (https://equibles.com/stocks/dea/short-interest). That is a slow build, not a crowded short. No usable options chain: ATM legs are not two-sided, skew is null, put/call OI is 0.73 on only 170 contracts. Sell-side is Hold-leaning: Benzinga shows 1 Buy, 4 Hold and 1 Sell; RBC is Underperform with a $24 target (2026-08-24) and Truist is Hold with a $26 target (2026-08-27). Earnings Whispers puts the post-Q2 drift at -9.1%, and the stock is 12% off its 52-week high, though up 3.1% over 5 days.

findings.finding: The FAA Great Lakes Regional Office is committed to GSA and OMB to vacate 2300 E. Devon Ave, Des Plaines by October 2026; its occupancy agreement expires 2026-10-20 and it moves to a 108,094 RSF space in Rosemont. It occupies about 186k RSF; the last GSA-published total annual cost was $5.1M (2000 lease). The Q3 release is the first document to state the post-October status, and the first 2027 guide carries a full year of that vacancy, worth an estimated $0.06-0.09/share of NOI, about 2-3% of the ~$3.10 Core FFO base, unless it is re-let or the FAA holds over.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: This is the first-year-guide line. On 2025-10-27, the day the 2026 guide ($3.05-3.12, midpoint below the $3.11 consensus) came out, the stock fell 4.0%. On 2026-08-03 the FY guide went up $0.01 at the midpoint despite a $0.01 quarterly miss, and the stock rose 3.82%.
findings.why_not_priced: The move-out is public and management told analysts on the Q2 call 'I would not add additional revenue in your model', so consensus 2026 likely excludes FAA rent after October. What is not public is the 2027 cost: the vacancy, carry costs and any re-let or disposal plan for a Class B suburban Chicago building, plus whether the FAA holds over (management said it was 'optimistic that they may stay a little bit longer' and promised an update). If that cost were priced, a 2027 consensus visibly below the 2-3% growth target would exist; none could be found. The upside tail (a holdover or extension) is in the range.
findings.independence: Management's own Q2 2026 call (https://www.marketbeat.com/earnings/reports/2026-8-3-easterly-government-properties-inc-stock/) confirms the October end and the instruction not to model more revenue. CoStar/WGN report the Rosemont lease at 42% smaller (https://www.costar.com/article/1419709252/faa-signs-largest-office-lease-this-year-in-chicago-suburbs). The RSF and rent come from the GSA FY2020 prospectus PIL-01-OH20 (https://gsa.gov/system/files/FY2020%20IL%20Chicago%20O%27Hare%20Area%20Department%20of%20Transportation%20Federal%20Aviation%20Administration.pdf); the current rent may differ.

findings.finding: The $127.5M Loma Linda mortgage at 3.6% matures in summer 2027, and management's primary plan is an investment-grade unsecured issuance with the revolver as a bridge. At roughly 5.5% that adds about $2.4M a year of interest, about $0.025/share in 2027 for half a year. The first 2027 guide will have to absorb it.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Same first-guide line as above (Oct 2025 -4.0%). No prior refinancing-driven reaction found.
findings.why_not_priced: It was disclosed on the call, but it only reaches a published number when 2027 guidance appears. Analysts on a Hold-heavy name may already model it, which is why it is sized small. If it were fully in the 2027 consensus, the guide midpoint would come in at or above consensus despite it.
findings.independence: Shares the call transcript with the FAA finding and the acquisition-threshold finding, but rests on a different fact (debt maturity versus tenant). The 10-Q debt schedule shows $149.3M of mortgage debt at 2026-06-30 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001622194/000162219426000024/dea-ex99_1.htm).

findings.finding: On the Q2 call the CEO said acquisitions become possible at $24.50-25.50, 'a couple hundred million' at $26-27 and 'very material' volume at $28-30. Spot is $22.505, below every tier, so the 2027 guide is likely to assume little external growth. He named JV capital with a sovereign wealth fund partner as the alternative if the stock does not improve by late 2026 or early 2027.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 2026 guide assumed only $50M of acquisitions, and that guide day was -4.0%. No precedent was found for a JV announcement.
findings.why_not_priced: The share price is public and the thresholds were said aloud, but the guide's acquisition assumption is not out yet. A JV announcement with the release would be the upside tail, which is why the high end is positive.
findings.independence: Same transcript as the two findings above. The stock is down 9.1% since the print, per Earnings Whispers PEAD (search snippet, https://www.earningswhispers.com/stocks/DEA).

findings.finding: Supports for the 2027 guide: procurement covers expirations 'through much of 2027', with mid-to-high-teens net effective rent growth expected. The FDLE Fort Myers lab (about 64k RSF, 25-year non-cancelable lease with the AAA State of Florida) is due to deliver in H2 2026 and starts rent. Lump-sum development reimbursements also delever without new equity.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The guide raise on 2026-08-03 coincided with a +3.82% day.
findings.why_not_priced: The delivery timing and rent-growth assumptions only become a number when the 2027 guide is published. The post-Q2 drift of -9.1% and Hold ratings suggest the market is not paying for them. If it were, the stock would sit near its 52-week high rather than 12% below it.
findings.independence: The Q2 2026 call (https://www.marketbeat.com/earnings/reports/2026-8-3-easterly-government-properties-inc-stock/) repeats delivery 'later this year' and the rent-growth expectation. This offsets the FAA finding on the same guidance line; the two are netted by being filed separately with opposite signs.

findings.finding: The Q3 Core FFO bar of $0.79 (two agreeing sources) sits above the ~$0.775/quarter H2 run-rate implied by the $3.07-3.13 guide midpoint and above Q2's $0.78. Q2 ATM issuance (796,943 shares) dilutes, no Q3 acquisition 8-K was filed, and the FDLE lab has not delivered. A $0.78 print, a 1c miss, is somewhat more likely than a beat.

findings.why_not_priced: It lands inside what the company guided, so it is mostly a told-to-expect item and is sized near zero. If the market expected a miss, the bar would be $0.78.
